taskBrief: Own the remaining Ticket 26 companion product path in this isolated worktree; do not modify Rules, Authority, battle actions, source data or strategy/replay code. First diagnose and remove CHARACTER_PACKAGE_HASH_PIN_STALE without weakening fail-closed integrity: replace brittle hand-updated package/catalogue constants with one versioned, registry-derived binding contract that validates the exact current sealed CharacterPackage, persona catalogue, selector, visual manifest and room/seat/principal scope. Old versioned projections remain readable only through an explicit legacy path; no silent compatibility. Then connect the existing createStarcraftTmgCompanionRoomSessionServiceV1 to the product through a narrow companion product module and Client Domain entry point. The Web/App floating Tactical Adjutant must open or resume a conversation for the authenticated human seat, select 1..6 registered companions, show deterministic speaker order and mentions, send a user turn, continue an interrupted provider turn explicitly, checkpoint/resume/close, and render persisted transcript, memory/relationship summaries and explicit Provider/BYOK unavailable/error states. It must never persist seat tokens, expose opponent-private plan/memory, request/store hidden chain-of-thought, fabricate a model reply, or gain Preview/Confirm/Apply authority. Keep all companion work isolated from the strategy/replay mainline. Use the existing injected provider port in the browser fixture to prove a complete two-companion user→A→B cycle, reload/resume, checkpoint isolation, wrong-seat rejection, zero Room mutations, and real portrait pixels at desktop and 390px. Do not call a paid Provider or refresh sources. Fix the stale hash failure so the existing component contract passes; do not allowlist or hide it. Build a current Web export inside the browser verifier only when stale. Record screenshots, claim-to-pixel/interaction receipts, exact changed files and remaining gaps. Run each declared gate once after the final relevant code change; only Critical/High block; stop after three non-converging repair rounds. Make scoped local commits and do not push.
